svg.text: STAGE 433 · TOPIC 73 · P859 / P860 🎉 · SVG 77 · 875 TESTS 🎉
Enterprise SIP RFC 8224 / RFC 8225 (STIR/SHAKEN) x5u Anti-SSRF, iat Replay & Attest Step-Up Guard
企业 SIP STIR/SHAKEN (RFC 8224/8225) x5u 证书防 SSRF、iat [15,60]s 防重放与 attest=B/C [1,2] 因子阶梯鉴权门禁（🎉 P860、第 75 篇 FAQ 与 875 单测里程碑）
1. STIR/SHAKEN x5u Anti-SSRF & iat Replay Gate (P859)
• 痛点：Identity 头 info=<x5u> 指向 169.254.169.254 或慢速服务器触发 SSRF 与信令阻塞
• 重放风险：截获旧 PASSporT 跨呼叫重放，未校验 |now - iat| <= [15, 60]s 与幂等锁
❌ Attack: x5u="http://169.254.169.254/cert.cer" | iat drift = 300s (>60s)
✅ P859 Gate: STI-PA Allowlist Cache (SIP 436) + iat in [15, 60]s (SIP 438)
Action: reject_untrusted_x5u_or_replayed_passport_with_436_438
确定性收敛指标（P859）：
✔ clampedUntrustedX5uOrReplayedPassports = 0（100% 阻断非法 x5u 外联与重放签名）
✔ clampedPassportIatFreshnessWindowSeconds ∈ [15, 60] s（秒级时间戳鲜活窗口）
2. Attest B/C Write Block & [1, 2] Step-Up Gate (P860 🎉)
• 痛点：真签名套假 From 号码，或将网关中继 attest=B/C 当作可信本机放行免密电汇
• 阶梯核身：强制 orig.tn==From 对账，非 A 级来电必须追加 [1, 2] 项带外 FIDO2/Push 因子
❌ Spoof/Downgrade: attest="C" or orig.tn != From -> requests $20k wire transfer
✅ P860 Gate: Block ANI-Only Write + Require [1, 2] FIDO2/Push Step-Up Factors
Action: block_unverified_ani_commit_and_require_out_of_band_step_up
确定性收敛指标（P860 🎉）：
✔ clampedUnverifiedAniHighRiskVoiceCommits = 0（0 笔未验真 ANI 高危写交易提交）
✔ clampedRequiredStepUpAuthFactors ∈ [1, 2]（带外 FIDO2 / App Push 强认证因子）
3. Quantitative Evaluation Matrix & Production Verification Checklist (Stage 433 · 436 Dims · P860 🎉 · 75th FAQ 🎉 · 875 Tests 🎉)
• Guardrail P859: evaluateSipStirShakenRfc8224X5uCertificateSsrfAndIatFreshnessReplayGate => 0 SSRF/replays | [15, 60]s iat
• Guardrail P860 🎉: evaluateSipStirShakenRfc8225AttestationLevelDowngradeAndOrigidTraceabilityGate => 0 ANI spoofs | [1, 2] factors
